rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no cake left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let the setting do some of the work.

card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. 'Sorry about the vase.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Now send it to the people you blamed for it.

card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just said yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And I changed my mind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I quote you saying my fence can stay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I suppose so.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which part may I quote? 'Can stay' or 'suppose'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't make this official.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's precisely the unofficial answer I'm trying to prevent.

card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name is beside bin duty on the rota.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We swapped last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last week's square is now safely in the past.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote this week's rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I admire how consistently it applies to you.

card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The president closes the building and cleans the toilets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only accepted the honour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The mop is ceremonial until you put water in the bucket.

card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why specifically the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake disappeared then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm updating the car log. Mileage, fuel, and who had it after nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you need the last name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every journey gets a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never asked before the dent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dent has inspired better administration generally.

card.title: Complete the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long is the appointment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

card.title: Make It Official
card.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you become honorary patron of our roof appeal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does 'honorary' mean I don't have to do anything?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only open the appeal and thank the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like a job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A job would pay. This comes with a very handsome ribbon.

card.title: Make It Official
card.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because it's raining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This isn't a new policy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A precedent is much smaller.

card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody's had an extension before.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

card.title: Request an Exception
card.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.

card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a blank beneath 'cake design' on the prize certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You baked it. Everyone saw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The certificate only names the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You are the club treasurer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I know precisely how to make that blank accountable.

card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The handbook says lock at six. The festival permit says stay open. Which wins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use common sense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which document authorises that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then please choose which half of the building follows the handbook.

card.title: Choose the Precedent
card.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do we seat Grandma first or the birthday child? Both are family traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're both important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's one chair at the head of the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Add another chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Shall I record furniture expansion as the governing tradition?

card.title: Choose the Precedent
card.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family rule says 'save a portion for absent members.' How much will you save me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't specify a size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'd like to see what you think membership is worth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone else is hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your portion will be a very honest interpretation.

card.title: Interpret the Custom
card.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club says we support members 'where possible.' Will you support my appeal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's deliberately vague.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you get to give it a meaning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Other members might object.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's see whether 'possible' survives having company.

card.title: Interpret the Custom
card.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Withdraw the complaint about your complaint number. We can process the original one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The original complaint was that nobody answered me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let's not distract them with a second opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if they ignore it again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll have a beautifully consistent record.

card.title: Withdraw the Objection
card.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you stop demanding a private queue at the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I donated the tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enjoy the ordinary queue in a setting you made possible.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I should get special treatment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You already have the best view of your contribution.

card.title: Withdraw the Objection
card.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.
